title: Plain Cheesecake (Classic No Bake)
description: No-bake simplicity at its finest — smooth, sweet, and forever dependable. A real fridge-set classic.

method.instruction: Combine the crushed Butternut Cookies with melted butter, then press firmly into the base of your tin.
Blend the Philadelphia Cream Cheese and condensed milk together until completely smooth.
Fold in the dissolved, cooled gelatin until evenly combined.
Pour the mixture over the base and refrigerate for 4–6 hours or overnight until set.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Slice with a hot knife for clean edges. Dress it up with berries, lemon zest, or a chocolate drizzle — or let the classic shine as-is.
